articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring unified multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene representations in a single context. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench Full and near-human performance on novel spatial reasoning tasks. The model also introduces a persistent memory layer that retains developer-defined project context across sessions.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad 2026
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved five out of six problems at the 2026 IMO, scoring 40 out of 42 points and earning a gold medal equivalent. The system uses a novel neuro-symbolic architecture that combines chain-of-thought transformer reasoning with a formal proof verifier. This marks a significant milestone in AI's ability to perform open-ended mathematical discovery rather than pattern matching on known problem types.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Shifts in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started supervised deployment in BMW's Spartanburg plant and select Amazon fulfillment centers, performing bin-picking, parts-kitting, and inventory scanning tasks. The Gen 3 units feature upgraded dexterous hands with 22 degrees of freedom and on-device vision-language models for interpreting natural language task instructions. Early reports cite a 4x improvement in task completion reliability over Gen 2.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Demonstrates Autonomous Multi-Robot Coordination
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at a $15 billion valuation after publicly demonstrating four Figure 02 humanoid robots autonomously coordinating to assemble furniture without human teleoperation. The system uses a shared world model and decentralized planning algorithm that allows real-time task decomposition and conflict resolution. The company plans to begin commercial deployments in automotive manufacturing by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Oversight Protocol for Autonomous AI Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new framework called Constitutional Oversight Protocol (COP) designed to provide real-time safety guardrails for long-running autonomous AI agents operating in production environments. COP uses a secondary monitor model that continuously evaluates an agent's planned actions against a configurable constitution before execution, with cryptographic audit logs. Several enterprise customers including Stripe and Notion are piloting the system for autonomous coding and customer support agents.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its 1.4nm A14 process has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, roughly two months ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, yielding approximately 25% performance gains and 35% power efficiency improvements over N2. Apple and Nvidia are expected to be lead customers, with first commercial chips shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 1 Trillion Active Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a mixture-of-experts model with over 1 trillion active parameters, under a newly permissive commercial license with no revenue cap. The model achieves performance competitive with GPT-5 on most public benchmarks and includes native tool-use and agentic capabilities out of the box. The release includes optimized serving infrastructure code that enables inference on a single 8xH200 node using aggressive quantization and speculative decoding.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in Automotive Testing
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its QSE-5 solid-state lithium-metal cells have surpassed 1,000 fast-charge cycles while retaining over 90% capacity in automotive-grade testing conditions, a key threshold for EV manufacturer adoption. The cells deliver an energy density of 500 Wh/kg, roughly double that of current lithium-ion packs, enabling projected ranges exceeding 600 miles. Volkswagen's PowerCo unit confirmed plans to integrate the cells into a production vehicle platform by late 2027.
